item.title: MC1523084: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Move email messages to quarantine with a new remediation action
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 introduces a "Move to Quarantine" remediation action, allowing admins to move suspicious emails from user mailboxes to Defender quarantine for safer investigation and management. Rollout begins late November 2026, with no action required but policy and role reviews recommended.

item.title: MC1530611: Office in Copilot brings the full power of Office into the Microsoft Copilot app
item.description: Microsoft Copilot now fully integrates Office apps, enabling users to create, edit, and collaborate on Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files within the Copilot app. The rollout completes by mid-November 2026. No admin action is required, but admins should inform users and review policies. Data processing and AI capabilities are expanded accordingly.

item.title: MC1539003: Microsoft Viva Engage: Improved shared message experience
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will enhance shared messages with richer previews including formatted text, images, videos, and attachments. Users can view and interact with full conversations on the web without losing their feed position. Rollout starts mid-November 2026, requiring no workflow changes but user communication is recommended.

item.title: MC1539002: Microsoft Copilot Chat: Planner Agent task assignment, catch-up, and Copilot memory integration
item.description: Microsoft Copilot Chat's Planner Agent is enhanced with task assignment, scheduled task catch-up, and memory integration to improve task management and personalized responses. Rolling out worldwide in December 2026, it supports shared basic plans, larger plans, and offers improved speed, reliability, and user control without admin action needed.

item.title: MC1539001: Microsoft 365 admin center: Project usage report retirement
item.description: The Project usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center will be retired on December 4, 2026, due to the retirement of Project Online and Project for the web. Administrators should export needed data by November 20, 2026, and use the Planner usage report instead. The Project desktop client remains supported.

item.title: MC1539000: Microsoft Outlook: Search within a selected folder
item.description: Outlook will allow users to limit search results to a selected mail folder, enhancing search control. This feature will roll out globally in mid-November 2026. No action or compliance concerns are required.

item.title: MC1538999: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot connectors in Work IQ APIs
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will extend Work IQ APIs to use data and tools from connected enterprise systems via Copilot connectors, enabling richer AI experiences without extra setup. Rollout starts late November 2026. Existing permissions, controls, and governance remain unchanged; no admin action is needed.

item.title: RM422817: Outlook: Insert signature into calendar events
item.description: Users can manually insert a signature into a calendar event like they can in the classic outlook. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM519571: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports – Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors
item.description: A new usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot, designed to give organizations a detailed view of how connectors are being used within Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report provides insights into overall connector activity, and connector powered response patterns over time, along with detailed user-level connectors adoption data. With these analytics, admins can monitor adoption, identify usage patterns, and optimize Copilot ex...

item.title: RM557675: Outlook: Share Word, Excel, and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
item.description: When working in an open Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file, users will now be able to send a copy of the locally stored file by email through the new Outlook for Windows. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM565222: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
item.description: Self-service diagnostics help identify common issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. The experience highlights potential misconfigurations and provides simple guidance to help customers understand and resolve them. This brings basic troubleshooting into the product and helps eDiscovery admins overcome common challenges.

item.title: RM565869: Microsoft Teams: Personal message reminders for chat and channels
item.description: Teams now lets you set and manage reminders directly on chat and channel messages, helping you keep track of important items. Create, update, complete, and delete reminders, track them in a dedicated Reminders view, and receive timely notifications when they become due. Reminders are private to each user and include message context, making them easy to revisit and act on when needed.

item.title: RM570467: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
item.description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

item.title: RM571399: Microsoft 365: Expiration for access on sharing main links
item.description: People can set expiration dates for “Anyone” and “People in your organization” access on the main link to files and folders in OneDrive and SharePoint. New administrator policies can Administrators can set policies to require expiration and enforce a maximum access duration, with separate settings for OneDrive and SharePoint. item.title: RM571400: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
item.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

item.description: Makers can now choose to display their data as a calendar or a stack of cards instead of the default grid layout. Makers can configure these layouts directly in the model driven app designer, giving users more intuitive ways to visualize and work with their data.

item.description: Enable project managers to view and track Committed Costs directly within Project Operations budgets, providing a complete picture of budget consumption beyond actual costs. This enhancement allows project managers to make more informed budgeting, forecasting, and project control decisions by incorporating costs that are contractually or operationally committed but not yet realized. This is for Project Operations core and Project Operations connected with ERP deployment types

item.description: Reimagine creation Phase In/Out rules.

item.title: RM578872: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling for legacy Office files
item.description: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will support legacy Microsoft Office file formats, including Word (.doc), Excel (.xls), and PowerPoint (.ppt). Organizations can automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to these files in SharePoint and OneDrive.

item.title: RM579184: Microsoft Teams: Multiple screen shares in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: You can now view up to two shared screens side by side during meetings, reducing interruptions from screen hand-offs. Participants can switch between side-by-side and expanded views, identify presenters for each screen, and benefit from layouts optimized for single or dual displays. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to orchestrate conversation distribution with natural language playbooks in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will be generally available by November 30, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to configure natural-language playbooks to automatically manage conversation priority, overflow handling, representative assignment, and routing as conditions change throughout the conversation lifecycle. item.description: We are announcing the ability to Use bullseye routing with user groups to orchestrate conversations in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability by November 6, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature introduces a tiered assignment strategy that automatically expands the pool of eligible customer service representatives as conversation wait times increase. Admins can configure a bullseye routing playbook, allowing them to associate user groups with a queue and...

item.title: MC1515937: Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery: In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
item.description: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery will introduce three read-only diagnostics for case access, security filters, and hold-policy distribution to help admins troubleshoot issues. Rollout begins December 2026 with general availability by early 2027. No admin action is required; diagnostics do not alter existing configurations.

item.title: MC1217640: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection - Content Explorer: Unscanned data and Classification History summary metrics
item.description: Microsoft Purview planned new summary metrics in Content Explorer to show unscanned files and classification history, aiding admins in data governance. Public preview was set for late July 2026, but general availability was canceled. No action is required; the feature would have been enabled by default.

item.title: MC1245222: Outlook: Share Word, Excel and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
item.description: Starting mid-January 2027, the new Outlook for Windows will support sending locally stored Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files as email attachments, replacing the need for classic Outlook. This feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and aims to streamline file sharing and align features between Outlook versions.

item.title: RM503571: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for refining query filters for Confluence Copilot connectors
item.description: This feature enhances and standardizes query filtering across both Confluence Cloud and Confluence On-premises connectors.

item.title: RM545063: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Insider risk management for agents
item.description: As AI agents become deeply embedded in enterprise ecosystems, they are evolving beyond simple tools or workflows into a digital workforce. These agents can interpret intent, access and manipulate enterprise data, execute actions and even make real-time decisions. In many ways, they operate like human insiders only with machine-speed data processing capabilities.

item.title: RM553591: Microsoft Teams: Building level insights on the Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: IT gets new building level insights on the recommended actions page in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal. This feature intelligently identifies buildings with high Teams Rooms utilization to help IT prioritize upgrades of bring your own device (BYOD) meeting spaces and ensure consistent, high-quality user experiences throughout their office buildings. Available with a Teams Rooms Pro or Shared Space license.

item.title: RM558286: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
item.description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

item.title: RM561026: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
item.description: We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint.

item.title: RM561204: Planner: My Tasks redesign
item.description: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

item.title: RM562535: Microsoft Teams: Assign Open Shifts
item.description: Auto Assign Open Shifts is a Microsoft Teams Shifts feature that automatically fills unassigned (open) shifts for you. It lets managers automatically assign open shifts to available employees instead of doing it manually. The system considers factors like employee availability, approved time off, past scheduling patterns, and scheduling rules (e.g., max hours, rest time); and generates a draft schedule that you can review and adjust before publishing.

item.title: RM565425: Microsoft Teams: Language selection by users in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now choose their preferred meeting language in Teams Rooms on Android. Select from up to 69 languages using the language button on the console. The room system must restart after a language is selected.

item.title: RM567306: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
item.description: Call delegation in Teams now includes new controls that give delegators greater privacy and control during active calls. Delegators can lock an ongoing call to prevent delegates from joining or resuming the call and can optionally enable warning tones that notify participants when a delegate joins or resumes a call.

item.title: RM567466: Microsoft Teams: Teams events attendance and engagement report policy
item.description: Teams events will soon have a separate attendance and engagement report policy from the "CsTeamsMeetingPolicy" attendance and engagement report policy. This will permit admins to allow Teams events organizers to access attendance and engagement reports, while restricting access to Teams meeting attendance and engagement reports.

item.title: RM568781: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

item.title: RM569207: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

item.title: RM569426: Planner: Private tasks now stored in your private plan
item.description: Private tasks created in Planner and Planner-powered experiences are stored in the user’s private plan, providing a single place for tasks visible only to that user. Private tasks cannot be shared or assigned to others, and existing tasks continue to work and appear alongside them.

item.title: RM569447: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

item.title: RM570445: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

item.title: RM571296: Microsoft Teams: Turn meeting discussions into PowerPoint presentations with Facilitator
item.description: When it's time to present what your team decided, you can ask Facilitator to create a PowerPoint presentation from what was said, chats, and shared files in the meeting. It turns the conversation into the slides, whether that's a project update, a proposal, or a readout for leadership. Facilitator can already draft documents in Word, so now your team can also go straight from discussion to a deck.

item.title: RM571299: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
item.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

item.title: RM573250: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
item.description: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the event

item.title: RM573602: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Split your expenses
item.description: Split a single expense across multiple allocations so costs are accurately assigned to the appropriate expense user, project, department, customer, or expense category. Expense Agent helps you define the split and ensures the allocations add up to the original expense amount. Each allocation is recorded separately for reporting and accounting while remaining linked to the original expense.

item.title: RM573603: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Log the expense in a case of lost receipt
item.description: Expense Agent helps employees keep expense submissions moving when an original receipt is unavailable. It guides employees through providing the information needed to support the expense, generates supporting documentation from those details, and enables them to continue the reimbursement process without manually creating replacement documentation.

item.title: RM573604: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expense with no attachment
item.description: Save time when recording lower-value expenses by creating them in Expense Agent without an attachment when the amount is below the limit you set on the Expense Agent Setup page. This gives you the flexibility to record qualifying expenses even when a receipt or supporting document isn’t available.

item.title: RM573605: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Enable approving limits and alternate approvers when primary is not available
item.description: Keep expense approvals moving when primary approvers are unavailable or when requests exceed their approval limits. Organizations can set a maximum approval amount—or unlimited approval authority—for each approver, designate a next approver for requests above that limit, and assign alternate approvers as temporary or scheduled backups. Approval requests can route to an alternate approver during periods of unavailability while following the same approval processes and controls.

item.title: RM573606: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add tags for expenses as submitter
item.description: Make expenses easier to organize and categorize by adding relevant tags when you create or edit expenses in the web application. Add one or more custom tags to capture business, project, event, or other dimensional context beyond standard expense fields.

item.title: RM573607: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Set expense spend limits in Expense Management
item.description: Take control of employee spending earlier in the expense process with configurable spend limits. Define thresholds that reflect your organization’s expense policies and apply them by time period for individual employees, teams, or the whole company. Expenses that exceed predefined limits can be prevented or flagged, with immediate feedback during expense creation.

item.title: RM573608: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Change companies and environments in the web app
item.description: Manage expenses across multiple Business Central companies and environments more efficiently with the Expense Agent web app. Switch between the companies and environments you’re authorized to access within a single session, without restarting the app or signing in again.

item.title: RM573609: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Adding invited guests from calendar as participants to your expense
item.description: Spend less time manually adding attendees to meal-related business expenses. Expense Agent can match the expense to the relevant Outlook calendar event and add invited guests as expense participants, helping keep participant information aligned with the meeting invitation.

item.title: RM573610: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use tags to mark processed emails
item.description: Quickly see which expense-related emails have already been processed by Expense Agent, helping you distinguish processed from unprocessed messages with confidence. Expense Agent adds a **Processed by Expense Agent **tag in Outlook after a relevant email has been successfully processed.

item.title: RM573613: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Cross-environment Master Data Management
item.description: Keep critical business data consistent across environments with cross-environment master data management. Centrally manage and govern master data—including customers, vendors, products, and reference data—and keep it synchronized wherever it is used, reducing duplicate maintenance and simplifying administration.

item.title: RM573614: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Use complex calculation methods for excise duties
item.description: Simplify excise duty calculations with flexible methods that better reflect your organization’s tax scenarios. Configure excise duties using specific, ad valorem, or hybrid calculation methods, including calculations based on different tax bases, thresholds, quantities, percentages, or combinations of these factors.

item.title: RM573615: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Configure and use bonded locations for excise duty calculations
item.description: Reduce manual work and support accurate excise duty handling by applying bonded-location rules to inventory. Designate warehouses or storage locations as bonded so excise duties can be deferred while goods remain in bonded storage and assessed when goods move to non-bonded locations or enter taxable circulation, according to configured tax rules.

item.title: RM573616: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Multiple VAT numbers for a vendor
item.description: Handle VAT correctly for vendors that operate across multiple European Union countries by recording multiple VAT numbers and applying the appropriate VAT Business Posting Group and General Business Posting Group for each transaction.

item.title: RM573617: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Germany - Export euBP with audit files export
item.description: Create more complete audit export packages with less manual preparation by exporting European Business Profile (euBP) information together with transactional audit data. Organizations using the German localization can include both in a single Audit Files Export process.

item.title: RM573618: Dynamics 365 Business Central: USA - Automate employee payments with ACH bank integration
item.description: Organizations in the United States can simplify employee expense reimbursements by paying approved claims directly to employees’ bank accounts through ACH. When used with the Expense Agent, approved reimbursements can be processed automatically, reducing manual payment handling and helping employees get reimbursed faster and more accurately.

item.title: RM573619: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Austria - Enable SAF-T audit file format

item.title: RM573621: Dynamics 365 Business Central: France - Install French localization as an extension to the base app
item.description: The localized version for France is now available as a set of extensions on the W1 base app. This version includes a data upgrade feature to simplify the transition from the previous localization. This release moves the product closer to full delocalization, so ISVs can reach a wider market. Some features move to the base app or become global apps, while others stay specific to the French market.

item.description: The localized version for Norway is now available as a set of extensions on the W1 base app. This version includes a data upgrade feature to simplify the transition from the previous localization. item.title: RM576280: Power Apps: Form fill assistance using Microsoft 365 files in model-driven apps
item.description: We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use Microsoft 365 files as a source, helping users turn existing content into form entries with less manual effort.

item.title: RM577399: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
item.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

item.title: RM577407: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Inventory validation and fulfillment options on the Store Commerce transaction grid
item.description: When store and trade-counter associates add items to a sale, they need to know right away whether the item can be fulfilled, and if not, what the options are. This feature brings real-time inventory validation and fulfillment options directly into the Store Commerce transaction grid, so associates don't need to leave the transaction to check stock.

item.title: RM577408: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Inventory view modernization on the Store Commerce app
item.description: Store Commerce inventory screens are being modernized with a new, responsive experience built on Fluent UI and React. The modern inventory views give store associates a consistent look and feel and fewer clicks across everyday inventory tasks, and they extend the modern inventory lookup experience to all inventory operations in the store.

item.title: RM577409: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Extend the phone Cart with custom app-bar commands
item.description: Add phone Cart commands and configurable sales-line details so Store Commerce extensions work consistently across device sizes.

item.title: RM577411: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Assign functionality profiles to self-checkout registers
item.description: This feature lets organizations assign a functionality profile directly to a self-checkout register in Commerce headquarters. The register-specific profile can control device settings, transaction reason codes, receipt numbering, and fiscal defaults for each kiosk.

item.title: RM577414: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Guide shoppers through an intuitive self-checkout flow
item.description: Guide shoppers with clearer self-checkout flows, configurable assistance, and register-specific settings across supported Store Commerce devices.

item.title: RM577746: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Marketing tools, skills and plugin are now available in Copilot Cowork
item.description: The Customer Insights plugin brings Dynamics 365 Customer Insights context, actions, and guided workflows to Copilot Cowork. Marketers and other customer-facing teams can understand customer profiles, author brand-compliant content, and prepare consent-aware outreach using existing segments directly in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365 Customer Insights.

item.title: RM577750: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Map keyboard shortcuts to common POS operations
item.description: Applies to: Point of Sale (Store Commerce); configured in Commerce headquarters.

item.title: RM577751: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design and print A4 and thermal receipts in a modern designer
item.description: Applies to: Point of Sale (Store Commerce app, Store Commerce for web), headquarters (Commerce headquarters receipt format designer), Hardware Station, Commerce Scale Unit.

item.title: RM577752: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Apply bulk actions to multiple transaction lines
item.description: Store associates can select multiple eligible transaction lines and apply common updates in one action, including voiding items, changing the delivery mode, and changing the fulfillment location. This capability reduces repetitive work and errors on large orders while preserving line-level validation and providing clear feedback when an update can't be applied.

item.title: RM577855: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Support larger invoices in Project Operations
item.description: The dual-write asynchronous integration feature in Project Operations enhances the customer invoicing process by enabling scalable and reliable data synchronization between Dataverse and Dynamics 365 Finance. This feature addresses the limitations of real-time dual-write sync, which is restricted to processing a maximum of 1,000 invoice lines per invoice.

item.title: RM577893: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design POS screen layouts in a modern browser designer
item.description: Create and preview POS screen layouts in headquarters with a modern web designer that simplifies configuration and reduces design iterations.

item.title: RM578858: Microsoft Teams: Shared call history in the Queues app on Mobile
item.description: Calling reps and Supervisor leads can view shared call history for their call queues in the Queues app on Mobile, helping them track call activity, review call details, and coordinate customer follow-ups while on the go.

item.title: RM578859: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile
item.description: Agents and supervisors can use Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile to quickly understand and follow up on customer conversations. From shared call history, users can ask questions about a past call and use Copilot to surface relevant information and insights from the conversation, helping them get up to speed and take the next step without having to review the entire call

item.title: RM578870: Microsoft Viva: Engage - Improved shared messages end-user experience
item.description: Improving the shared conversation experience in Viva Engage to so it's easier for users to discover, read, and participate.

item.title: MC1506730: Classic Outlook for Windows: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
item.description: Classic Outlook for Windows will receive visual updates like improved icons, spacing, and alignment starting November 2026 to enhance clarity and consistency without changing workflows. A monthly nonintrusive "What’s New" dialog will inform users. No admin action is required; users and help desks should be informed.

item.title: MC1537497: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Refreshed Analytics
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal will get a refreshed Analytics & Reports experience with updated design, simplified navigation, and new Room and Desk analytics sections. Rollout starts December 2026, completing by January 2027. No action or compliance concerns for admins.

item.title: MC1537495: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Discover featured AI Skills Navigator playlists in Learning Agent
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Learning Agent will feature AI Skills Navigator playlists, offering curated learning resources via natural language queries. Rolling out worldwide in mid-November 2026, this enhances skill-building for users where AI Skills Navigator is enabled, with no action required but settings review recommended.

item.title: MC1537494: Attention needed: Your tenant will be auto enabled for the new Microsoft Defender RBAC model
item.description: Microsoft Defender RBAC will be auto-enabled in your tenant starting December 2026, unifying access management for Defender and Sentinel. Existing roles will be imported for review before activation about 30 days after notification. Adjust roles as needed; opt-out is available post-activation. Other Microsoft service permissions remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1537490: Intelligent call delegation is planned to change from Frontier public to public preview (Ring 3.6) as early as Nov 17th
item.description: Intelligent call delegation moves from Frontier to public preview (Ring 3.6) starting Nov 17, 2026, using AI to screen calls and schedule via Microsoft Bookings. Rollout runs Nov-Dec 2026; general availability in Jan 2027. Usage-based billing requires admin spending policy setup in Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1488845: Private tasks now stored in your private plan in Planner
item.description: Starting December 2026, private tasks in Microsoft Planner will be stored in users' private Planner plans instead of Microsoft To Do, enabling richer Planner features while maintaining privacy and compliance. Existing tasks remain visible, no admin action is needed, and organizations should update related documentation and governance processes.

item.title: MC1488844: Updated My Task experience in Planner
item.description: Microsoft Planner's My Tasks experience will be redesigned for clearer navigation, better task organization, and streamlined task creation. The update rolls out worldwide from early to late December 2026, requires no user action, and maintains existing data and policies. Organizations should inform users and update training materials accordingly.

item.title: MC1532253: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams is replacing the Copilot meeting policy with two new policies—MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI—for clearer control over AI features and transcription in meetings. Rollout begins December 2026. Existing settings will be automatically mapped; admins should update scripts and review configurations accordingly.

item.title: MC1537406: Power Automate - Information regarding the end of support for Describe it to design it
item.description: On November 30, 2026, Describe it to design it in Power Automate will have reached end of support. How does this affect me? Makers in your organization will no longer be able to create new cloud flows using Describe it to design it. This retirement doesn't delete or move existing flows. Makers can still create and edit flows in the visual designer and start from templates. What action do I need to take? item.title: RM573625: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC, GCC High and DoD

item.title: RM576711: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for Teams Events
item.description: AI Interpreter for Events brings real-time, AI-powered audio interpretation to Teams Town Halls and Webinars, helping global audiences follow events in their preferred language. Organizers can configure supported languages for their event, giving attendees a more natural and engaging multilingual experience beyond translated captions.

item.title: RM577392: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Education] Create multi-week unit plans with Teach
item.description: Educators can use Teach in Microsoft 365 Copilot to create structured unit plans that span multiple lessons or weeks. They can customize the plan components to organize connected lesson plans and quizzes across a unit.

item.description: Frontier is expanding to bring eligible public preview features across Microsoft 365 into one program. Users enrolled in Frontier can get eligible previews for new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, managed through a single admin-controlled enrollment experience. item.title: MC1532248: Activity in other accounts and orgs panel improvements
item.description: The 'Activity in Other Accounts and Orgs' panel in Teams will allow users to preview and open chats and channels from multiple accounts without tenant switching. item.title: MC1532242: Microsoft Teams: Pinch to zoom in on shared screens
item.description: Microsoft Teams will add pinch-to-zoom on shared screens using touchpads, enhancing visibility of small text and details. item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR's CallActivityEvents table enables security teams with Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 to investigate suspicious Microsoft Teams calls and meetings by analyzing activities, initiators, organizers, and related messages. item.description: Microsoft Purview will support Data Loss Prevention and auto-labeling for non-Microsoft apps like Google Workspace, Box, and Salesforce via Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. item.description: Microsoft Edge for Business now supports Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to summarize and provide context from multiple open tabs and YouTube videos. item.description: Microsoft Entra ID now generally supports Choose Your Own Telephony Provider (CYOT) for SMS and voice authentication, retiring Microsoft-provided services by February 1, 2027. Organizations must select a provider, set up CYOT, and transition before that date, while Microsoft recommends phishing-resistant methods like passkeys.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting memory files starting January 2027 to enhance Copilot and Facilitator with context-aware insights. Files are stored securely in tenant-owned SharePoint, not user storage, with admin controls for enabling, retention, and compliance. Users cannot access files directly; data privacy is maintained.

item.description: Microsoft will retire Microsoft Purview DSPM classic and DSPM for AI classic experiences by late March 2027, unifying capabilities into a single current DSPM experience. Organizations using the classic versions must transition workflows and update documentation accordingly; no action is needed if already using the current DSPM.

item.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy will replace EWS by November 2026. Organizations must migrate to avoid service disruption; migration guidance and updates are provided.

item.title: MC1530957: Microsoft Teams: Threads will become the default layout for new channels created with Microsoft Graph
item.description: Starting late November 2026, new Microsoft Teams channels created via Microsoft Graph without a specified layoutType will default to the Threads layout ("chat"). Existing channels remain unchanged. Organizations should update automation to specify "post" if Posts layout is required or test workflows for compatibility with Threads.

item.title: MC1187781: Viva Engage: Community feeds improvements
item.description: Viva Engage communities will default to viewing conversations by recent posts instead of recent activity, with unread indicators in both "new" and "all" feeds. This change, rolling out November 2026, offers a sticky user preference for feed and sort order, improving content browsing without requiring action.

item.title: MC1530954: Microsoft 365 apps: Draft mode for official Brand Kits
item.description: Draft Mode for official Brand Kits in Microsoft 365 apps allows Brand Managers to create and review changes without affecting the live kit until published. It rolls out worldwide from late October to early November 2026. No action is required, but informing Brand Managers is recommended.

item.title: MC1530950: Microsoft Teams: Explicit consent for PSTN participants in one-to-one calls
item.description: Microsoft Teams will require explicit consent via phone keypad for PSTN participants in one-to-one calls when recording or transcription starts, beginning early December 2026. Participants can consent or decline; those who decline remain muted. This uses existing calling policies with no new settings introduced.

item.title: MC1530948: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling support for legacy Microsoft Office file formats
item.description: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling will support legacy Office files (.doc, .xls, .ppt) in SharePoint and OneDrive starting November 2026. Existing policies need a minor edit and rerun to include these formats. New policies support them automatically. This affects organizations using Purview auto-labeling for these platforms.

item.title: RM494839: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
item.description: Learn about the state of your scanned repositories and create custom reports with the information protection scanner. Labeling, classification and protection actions on scanned files are stored in SQL tables that form a foundation to feed into custom reports.

item.title: RM502520: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
item.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing. New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

item.title: RM554934: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

item.description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes. item.description: When sorting on Outlook for Web or Outlook for Windows, if the Sort By field is not one of From, Subject, or Date Received, we will now show an additional column for the Sort By value (e.g., Size). We will also support sorting by Flag Due Date.

item.title: RM567888: Outlook: All Day events to show up more clearly in the Mail module Calendar Preview
item.description: We're making it easier to tell when receiving meeting invites that conflict with scheduled Out of Office time or Busy All Day events, on Outlook Web and Outlook for Windows.

item.title: RM573156: Microsoft Teams: Start side conversations during meetings
item.description: Keep collaboration moving without disrupting the main discussion. Start and continue one-to-one or small-group conversations directly from a meeting to ask questions, coordinate next steps, share information, and collaborate in parallel while staying engaged in the conversation, reducing context switching and helping teams stay focused and productive.

item.description: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

item.title: RM576274: Microsoft Viva: Network analytics enhancements
item.description: Network analytics updates are rolling out in Microsoft Viva Engage, giving corporate communicators and network admins more flexibility to analyze activity and engagement across their organization.

item.title: RM577176: Microsoft Teams: Decline a call with a message on Mobile
item.description: Users can quickly decline an incoming Teams call and send a predefined message to the caller at the same time. From the incoming call screen, users can select a message such as letting the caller know they're unavailable or will call back, providing helpful context without having to answer the call or separately open a chat.

item.title: RM577744: Dynamics 365 Sustainability: Enhance external sustainability reporting
item.description: This feature delivers enhancements to the external reporting experience with an improved standards and assessments structure and enhanced search capabilities. Users can navigate standards, assessments, and concepts more efficiently, reducing time spent locating and managing reporting content across complex disclosures. item.title: RM577834: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Copilot studio cost controls in MAC
item.description: We’re expanding cost management for Microsoft Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center. item.category: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

item.title: RM577858: Dynamics 365 Finance: Enhance positive pay file generation through batch processing
item.description: This feature improves the scalability and performance of positive pay file generation by enabling the process to run as a background batch job. Organizations that generate large positive pay files can now offload processing from the interactive user session, reducing the risk of timeouts and improving the overall user experience. The enhancement is designed to support high-volume check payment scenarios while maintaining the existing positive pay functionality and output formats.

item.description: Price override allows sales representatives to adjust the preset price of a product during a transaction—typically for business purposes such as customer negotiations and retention. Previously, price override validation only enforced amount-based thresholds, without evaluating how the override would impact profit margins. Unified pricing management now provides margin check capabilities for price overrides across all order entry channels available in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.

item.title: RM577894: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Enable fulfillment optimization in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
item.description: Distributed order management (DOM) can now optimize fulfillment for standard sales orders in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. Previously, DOM was available only for Dynamics 365 Commerce orders. Now you can use the same rules-based fulfillment engine to automatically choose the best site and warehouse for each sales order line, without depending on Commerce or retail configuration.

item.title: RM80239: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
item.description: Two presenters can share a screen or window at the same time in a Teams meeting. Participants can see both shared content streams simultaneously, making it easier to compare and discuss content from different presenters.

item.description: Teams Android device management is transitioning from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal by July 2026 (public cloud) and late 2026 (GCC clouds). PMP will unify device management with enhanced features; TAC device management will be deprecated by January 2027. Admins should prepare accordingly.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out impersonation protection for meetings in December 2026, displaying warnings and risk indicators to help users identify deceptive participants. No admin action is needed, but admins should inform users and security teams. This feature enhances security by highlighting potential impersonation attempts.

item.description: The new Outlook for Windows introduces an All Accounts view, allowing users to see and manage emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox without merging mailboxes. item.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. item.description: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.

item.title: RM570648: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization on Teams Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal, similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today. item.title: RM571306: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
item.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. item.description: OneDrive for the web is updating the placement of the Create or upload button to provide a more consistent file experience across OneDrive and SharePoint. item.description: Starting November 2026, Microsoft Frontier expands to offer public preview features in Teams, new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, and SharePoint, alongside Copilot. item.title: MC1446805: Microsoft Viva: Targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva introduces targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard, allowing authorized users (CxO or delegates) to send Viva Pulse surveys to predefined Copilot user groups based on dashboard data. item.title: MC1490906: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization in Teams Pro Management portal

Organizations should ensure their meeting providers and integrations generate HTTPS links to avoid impact. No action is needed if HTTPS URLs are already used.

item.title: MC1528006: Microsoft Authenticator: Improved backup and restore experience for Android

item.title: MC1528003: Microsoft Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
item.description: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone enables natural language editing and task continuation outside the app. Rolling out worldwide from late October to November 2026, it enhances mobile Excel use with secure Microsoft 365 integration, allowing quick data insights, edits, and formula updates without compliance concerns.

item.title: MC1528000: Microsoft Entra ID: Reminder to migrate from Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will retire Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication starting February 1, 2027.
